response.overview: DAY6 marked their milestone 10th anniversary on August 30–31, 2025, by becoming the first-ever K-pop band to headline a standalone outdoor stadium show at Goyang Stadium. The historic two-night, sold-out event drew tens of thousands of fans in person and reached a global audience online through the Beyond LIVE streaming platform. Despite the intense summer heat and humidity, the open-air venue amplified the group’s stadium-rock energy with extensive pyrotechnics and massive light production. Over the course of the weekend, the band delivered a high-octane performance featuring a massive setlist of over thirty songs that spanned thirteen different albums from their decade-long career.
response.title: Day6 "The Decade" in Goyang
